summary: User-specific categories should be persisted in the backend, load automatically on login, and always display directly below "Favorites" (with create-category entry in that section), remaining visible unless deleted.
architectural_notes: Categories are per-user (not global) and must be stored in backend; client should fetch/load categories on login and render them directly below "Favorites".
known_issues: On login, previously created categories are not appearing; categories need to persist per user and be loaded from backend.

existing_features.title: On successful login, automatically load categories from the backend and render them immediately below the "Favorites" control in the category UI.
Add an always-available "Create category" entry directly below the "Favorites" control, and ensure creating a category persists it to the backend for the current user.
Ensure all category mutations from the UI (create, rename, delete) call the backend-backed sync actions so the backend remains the source of truth after login.

new_feature_requests.summary: Persist per-user categories in backend and auto-load/display them under "Favorites" immediately on login (remain until deleted; include create-category entry below Favorites).
Ensure categories are persisted per authenticated user in the backend and are returned for that same user after logging out and logging back in.
Fix backend category CRUD semantics so that category identity used by the frontend (category name strings) matches backend storage and prompt detaching/renaming logic end-to-end.
Persist backend state across canister upgrades for per-user prompts and categories so that user-created categories are not lost after deployment upgrades.
